items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 06 July 2026 at 10:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure from the Azores High to central Europe. Low to the southwest of Iceland.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5, becoming variable 2 to 4 later tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, occasionally moderate towards the English coast.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but some mist near Anglesey and Liverpool Bay at times.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming poor in places affected by mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
